name: Iru Endpoint Management
summary: Iru, the company behind the Kandji product line, sells Endpoint Management for Apple devices and Windows. It publishes no dollar prices. Pricing depends on the solutions chosen and the number of users and devices, and contracts are annual commitments billed annually with a 14-day free trial.

facts.text: Enrollment works through Automated Device Enrollment in Apple Business Manager for zero-touch setup, or through an Enrollment Portal for devices that are not in Apple Business Manager.
Iru's documentation says MDM pushes configuration changes almost instantly to Macs and within a couple of minutes to Windows devices, and daily check-ins correct local drift.
Lock Device works on macOS, iOS, iPadOS and visionOS without supervision, and a locked device cannot receive an Erase Device command.
Kandji's documentation says users should complete the migration from Kandji to Iru by December 1, 2026 to keep uninterrupted access.
The security page states completion of a SOC 2 Type 2 examination and ISO 27001 certification.
